measurement: All-thread descendant RSS sampled every 100 ms; shared pages may count repeatedly and short peaks may be missed. Waited process RSS is separate.
scope: Type-only receiver layout audit anchored to the reproduced And/accessor/Boolean/sole-callee identity chain. No typed body trace. interpretation.emptyBase: The selected receiver has an explicitly empty1/1 fieldless direct base and optimized-empty subobject at0. BaseSubobject supplies no occupied size; none is synthesized. Explicit lowered carrier fields/complete Size already supply the observed embedding quantities without reconstructing C++ EBO.
interpretation.pointerScope: Pointer field own representation/qualifiers/pointee identity are retained; VectorBuffer and controlblock pointee graphs remain unexpanded. Current eager pointer TypeName planning is a separate consumer representation gap requiring scoped use-site policy before implementation.
interpretation.nonacceptance: No body is typed-traced, no ownership/copy/destruction behavior is inferred, and no method/record/NoThrow/native product permission is created by this audit.

limits: Exactly four seeded record identities within declared maxima8records/64types/16fields/4bases/8subobjects/wrapperdepth16 are described; no recursive new base/value/pointee graph, methods, constants or RTTI are traversed.
Parent selector operation/receiver identity inventories locate actual public entities and remain outside zero target-body counters.
Complete/nonvirtual/partner extents remain distinct recorded quantities. Missing direct subobject occupied size is explicit metadata absence, not semantic failure or license to infer a formula.
